name: 原则：造杠杆
description_zh: 对任何非平凡工作（不仅是批量活）：先造一个工具来完成或证明它（codemod、脚本、生成器，或子代理遵循的技能），而不是手工做。工具是可重跑的产物，也是审查者能复核的工件。
description_en: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead of working by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer can rerun.
